thread:
jon (CS): Hey team — customer (Acme Financial) is pressing for SOC2 evidence and a remediation timeline for a transitive vuln in our image-builder. They want SBOM + proof-of-patch + audit log export for last 90 days. Also asked if KMS key rotation could have caused the regression. Need answer by EOD Friday. @maria can you triage? :grimacing:

maria (Security): On it. Can you paste the CVE they referenced? I saw a mention of CVE-2025-4512 in email but need exact links.

jon (CS): Here's the snippet from the customer's mail: "CVE-2025-4512 (libcompress), transitive via image-builder -> thirdparty/pkg@v1.2.3". They also asked for remediation proof (PR/commit) and postgres audit logs. They want timeline for patching production within 2 weeks.

maria (Security): Triage notes: CVE-2025-4512 affects libcompress < 4.6.0. We build image-builder with v1.2.3 of thirdparty/pkg which pins libcompress 4.5.9. That is vulnerable. Severity: High. Exploitability: low but exploitable in multi-tenant contexts. Priority: P1 for Dedicated/private customers, P2 for hosted depending on exposure.

lee (Infra): For hosted instances, we can do a rolling redeploy with the updated base image. Compatibility risk: ~5% for legacy plugins. Suggest canary to 5% traffic, run smoke + evals. Window: ~30m per cluster. ETA depends on image build pipeline.

maria (Security): Proposed remediation plan:
- Bump thirdparty/pkg -> v1.2.4 which pulls libcompress 4.6.1 (patched)
- Run full CI, include e2e with plugin matrix
- Canary rollout 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on errors
Target timeline: build+CI by Tue 12:00, canary Wed, full roll Fri.

jon (CS): Customer wants SBOM and evidence. What do we provide?

maria (Security): Provide SBOM for the affected image (CycloneDX JSON), commit PR link, CI run id, and a signed release manifest. For SOC2 audit they also asked for auth/audit logs extraction — @lee can you export auth/audit events for the image-builder service for the last 90 days scoped to KMS operations?

lee (Infra): Yes. Command I ran for the customer (example):

``nredwood-logs export --service image-builder --start 2025-10-01 --end 2025-12-30 --filter 'event:kms* OR resource:auth' --format csv --out image-builder-audit-90d.csv
``n
That extracts audit events (KMS encrypt/decrypt/rotate) and auth events. We need approval to include subject ids (PII). Recommend redacting emails before sending.

sec-oncall-bot: Incident ticket created: SEC-2025-322 — CVE-2025-4512 transitive in image-builder. Owner: maria (Security). Priority: High.

maria (Security): Note on KMS rotation: we rotated key arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/abcd on 2025-11-15 for housekeeping. No config changes to image-builder that would introduce libcompress; rotation is unrelated.

jon (CS): Customer also asked for KMS proof of key rotation plan and key IDs. Can we provide a redacted key rotation log and confirmation when rotation last happened?

lee (Infra): We can provide key rotation timeline (dates + key aliases) and confirmation that all services used envelope keys — we will redact key material. Example export command:

``naws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[?starts_with(KeyId, `abcd`)]' --output json > kms-keys.json
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <id> --output json
``n
I'll prepare redacted logs and include them with the SBOM package.

maria (Security): Ownering and next steps:
- maria: open PR, run CI, post CI link to thread
- lee: prepare audit log csv (redacted), prepare KMS rotation timeline
- jon: tell customer tentative timeline and ask if they need additional artifacts (signed manifests)

jon (CS): I'll reply now with Tue/Wed/Fri timeline and ask if they need anything else. Thanks all :pray:

lee (Infra): Quick note on prioritization: because this is transitive we should consider backport to older image tags used by Dedicated customers. I'll enumerate which clusters use older tags and propose patch window per cluster.

maria (Security): Also adding mitigations if immediate patching is blocked: runtime WAF rule to block exploit patterns, and restrict image-builder access to internal-only for affected time.

jon (CS): Customer replied: "Ok for canary, but need SBOM + audit CSV before canary start." I'll send a follow-up to confirm redaction and delivery mechanism (SFTP + signed link).

maria (Security): I'll upload artifacts to secure bucket and share signed link with CS. Tagging SEC-2025-322 for traceability.

sec-oncall-bot: SEC-2025-322 updated: status -> in_progress, assignee -> maria.

jon (CS): Thanks — looping legal on the redaction template. Will update customer after artifacts are ready.

maria (Security): CI green, PR: https://github.com/redwood/image-builder/pull/821
Build id: build-2025-11-28-77
Canary scheduled Wed 14:00 UTC. Leaving notes here when export done.

lee (Infra): Audit export done, file: s3://redwood-audit-exports/SEC-2025-322/image-builder-audit-90d.csv (redacted). KMS timeline doc: s3://redwood-keys/rotations/SEC-2025-322-kms-rotation.csv

jon (CS): Sharing with customer via SFTP now. Marking thread until confirmation.

maria (Security): Close loop: after canary completes, we'll monitor for 72h and then proceed full rollout. Thanks team :rocket:
